journal_lines: Chased prey through dense timber. The hunter and the woodcutter moved as one — one flushed, the other cut off the retreat.
Found a clearing mid-chase. The trees came down around the quarry. Efficient.
The forest worked for both of them today. Prey and timber, same ground, same hour.
Brought down a tree that brought down the chase. Two tasks in one swing.
Followed prey through brush so thick the axe earned its keep along the way.
Hunter set the trap. Woodcutter built the trap, mostly out of necessity.
Quarry went one way. Took the timber on the way back to it.
Trees fell. Quarry fell. The forest sorted itself out around the work.
